description.value:
Activation: *

You Snap, gaining one Allomantic power. At first, you can only use a rudimentary version of your power—and you might not even be aware you’re doing it. But after practice or training, you can master your power.

When you acquire this talent, you Snap, becoming a Misting and gaining the following benefits:

  • You gain access to Investiture, beginning with a maximum Investiture of 2 + your Awareness or Presence (whichever is higher). You can now use the @UUID[Compendium.cosmere-rpg-mistborn-handbook.actions.Item.ehYX5usckYd0wiFK]{Drink Vial} action.

  • You gain the Allomancy skill on your character sheet, starting with 1 rank in it. It uses your Willpower attribute.

  • Choose one Allomantic power available in your era (see “@UUID[Compendium.cosmere-rpg-mistborn-handbook.handbook.JournalEntry.Wdux6AlRp01Ox3EQ.JournalEntryPage.km12jL6JCxRZEm9N]{Metals of Scadrial}” in chapter 6). You can only use the nascent version of your chosen power for now (unless you choose @UUID[Compendium.cosmere-rpg-mistborn-handbook.metallic-arts.Item.QhP9qR99zbA9OMSG]{Atium Allomancy}).

Additionally, you gain the Metalborn goal “Train Your Power” (unless your power is @UUID[Compendium.cosmere-rpg-mistborn-handbook.metallic-arts.Item.QhP9qR99zbA9OMSG]{Atium Allomancy}). After completing this goal, you gain its reward: You unlock the full version of your power and can choose talents from its talent tree in chapter 6.
